spans.s:
अर्ज् 1. अर्ज्, cl. 1. P. अर्जति, आनर्ज, अर्जिष्-
यति, -जितुम्, to procure; to acquire, reach,
gain, earn: Caus. अर्जयति, -यितुम्, to procure, ac-
quire; to work or manufacture; to make or prepare.

अर्ज् 2. अर्ज् (a doubtful root, probably
distinct from the last, and connected with
रज्, राज्, and अर्च्), to shine, to be white (?).

अर्जक, अस्, इका, अम्, procuring, acquiring; (अस्),
m., N. of several plants, Ocymum Gratissimum L.,
&c.

अर्जन, अम्, n. procuring; acquiring, gaining,
earning; gathering.
अर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, acquired, gained, earned.

अर्जुन, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, white, clear, the colour
of day; of silver; (अस्), m. the white colour; a
peacock; cutaneous disease; the tree Terminalia
Arjuna W. and A.; a N. of Indra; N. of the third
of the Pāṇḍava princes, who was a son of Indra and
Kuntī; N. of a son of Kṛtavīrya, who was slain by
Paraśurāma; N. of a Śākya; N. of a country; the
only son of his mother; (ई), f. a procuress, a bawd;
cow; a kind of serpent; Uṣā wife of Aniruddha; N.
of a river, more commonly called Bāhudā or Karatoyā;
(न्यौ or न्यस्), du. or pl., N. of the constellation
Phalgunī; (अम्), n. silver; gold; slight inflammation
of the conjunctiva or white of the eye; grass; (आस्), m.
pl. the descendants of Arjuna.
—अर्जुन-काण्ड, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. having a white appendage.
—अर्जुन-
च्छवि, इस्, इस्, इ, of a white colour, white.
—अर्जुन-
तस्, ind. on the side or party of Arjuna.
—अर्जुन-
ध्वज, अस्, m. having a white banner, an epithet of
Hanumat.
—अर्जुन-पाकी, f., N. of a plant and its
fruits.
—अर्जुनारिष्ट-सञ्छन्न (˚न-अर्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, covered with Arjuna and Nimb trees.
—अर्जुनो-
पम (˚न-उप्˚), अस्, m. the teak tree, Tectona
Grandis L.

अर्जुनक, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to Arjuna; (अस्),
m. a worshipper of Arjuna.

अर्जुनस, अस्, आ, अम्, overgrown with Arjuna
plants.

आर्जव आर्जव, अम्, n. (fr. ऋजु), straight-
ness, straight direction; rectitude, propriety of act or
observance; honesty, open behaviour; sincerity.

आर्जीक आर्जीक, अस्, m. (cf. ऋजीक), Ved.
originally perhaps a milk-vessel. This word probably
denotes a celestial vessel, in which the heavenly Soma
is purified, or one of the rivers which it forms in
the sky; (Sāy.) a lake in the country Ṛjīkā.

आर्जीकीय, अस्, m. = the preceding; (आ), f. a terres-
trial river; N. of the river Vipāśā.

आर्जुनायन आर्जुनायन, आस्, m. pl. (fr. अर्-
जुन), N. of a people.

आर्जुनायनक, अस्, ई, अम्, inhabited by the Ārju-
nāyanas.

आर्जुनि आर्जुनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from
Arjuna.
आर्जुनेय, अस्, m. a patronymic of Kutsa.

आर्जविन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. आर्जव), having honesty,
upright, honest, straightforward.
